label: Написать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for написать (to write, perfective).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Напишу' uses the mutated stem пиш-; перфектив написать has future meaning in its simple form. The imperfective partner is писать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Напишешь' keeps the stem-final ш and the -ешь ending. The perfective stresses a finished essay by the deadline.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Напишет' is the он-form ending in -ет. 'Ответ' is the accusative object of the completed action.

missions.phrase: Мы напишем отчёт за один день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Напишем' shows the мы-ending -ем on the пиш- stem. 'За один день' marks the time within which the report is finished.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Напишут' closes the future paradigm with the -ут ending. 'Вам' is the dative recipient, 'план' the accusative object.

missions.phrase: Он написал книгу за два года.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Написал' is the masculine singular past of perfective написать. The aspect marks a completed result, the finished book.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Написала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Маме' is dative, 'короткое сообщение' the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Написали' is the plural past ending in -и. With экзамен the verb means to complete a written test.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Напиши' is the informal command of perfective написать. The perfective requests one specific, completed message.
Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Нужно' takes the bare infinitive 'написать'. The dative 'мне' marks the writer; the perfective points to one letter to be finished.
